id: \bOh, you found me? Well I guess you made it through the mansion. I'll tell the sailor to let you go the Gym.
en: \bOh, you found me? Well I guess you made it through the mansion. I'll tell the sailor to let you go the Gym.
it: \bOh, mi hai trovato? Beh, direi che hai superato la villa. Dirò al marinaio di lasciarti andare alla Palestra.

id: \bThis place used to be full of scientists working on some new Pokémon.
en: \bThis place used to be full of scientists working on some new Pokémon.
it: \bUna volta questo posto era pieno di scienziati che lavoravano su un nuovo Pokémon.

id: \bDid you come to look at this place too?
en: \bDid you come to look at this place too?
it: \bAnche tu sei venuto a dare un'occhiata a questo posto?
